scenario.description: Task 8.5 (D7) test run on one Runpod A40, after llm-quant-a40 in the same session: the quantized-LoRA option, chosen before any result (2026-10-24): the pinned adapter all-r4 on the W4A16 GPTQ base (the 4-bit rung 8.4 names), with the compact prompt, records the frozen test split once, with the deployment flags of llm-quant-a40 (prefix caching on). The other options already have their one test run: the hosted model (E-036), the base few-shot and the BF16 adapter (E-074). No load test (llm-quant-a40 has it). Scored on the laptop by the replayed eval (make eval-replay SPLIT=test).

notes: Closed-loop load on the planner's real first-attempt prompts (dev questions), warmup excluded; times are measured on the pod (client and server on one host). valid_rate = first-attempt replies that parse and pass the planner's validation.
